USURER-DEBT.title: Debt
USURER-DEBT.description: Financial leverage tied to your real [gold]Gold[/gold]. At the end of your turn, increases by [blue]+20%[/blue] Interest (rounded up), then if you are [gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold] ([blue]10+[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]), you lose [blue]Debt / 5[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and HP. Unpaid [gold]Debt[/gold] is settled from your [gold]Gold[/gold] after combat.
USURER-BORROW.title: Borrow
USURER-BORROW.description: Immediately gain real [gold]Gold[/gold] and an equal amount of [gold]Debt[/gold] to fuel undercosted cards and [gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold] effects.
USURER-REPAY.title: Repay
USURER-REPAY.description: Spend your [gold]Gold[/gold] (or force enemies via [gold]Lien[/gold] and [gold]Foreclose[/gold]) to remove [gold]Debt[/gold]. When enemies pay off your [gold]Debt[/gold], you keep the borrowed [gold]Gold[/gold] as profit!
USURER-OVER_LEVERAGED.title: Over-Leveraged
USURER-OVER_LEVERAGED.description: Active while you have [blue]10[/blue] or more [gold]Debt[/gold]. Empowers high-leverage cards and relics, but triggers turn-end [gold]Gold[/gold] & HP Installment payments unless paused by [gold]Moratorium[/gold].
USURER-LIEN.title: Lien
USURER-LIEN.description: Collateral debuff on an enemy. Whenever hit by an Attack, the enemy takes damage equal to its [gold]Lien[/gold] and pays off [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Debt[/gold] (or grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] if you have [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]).
USURER-FORECLOSE.title: Foreclose
USURER-FORECLOSE.description: Consume all [gold]Lien[/gold] stacks on an enemy to deal burst damage per stack and force the enemy to pay off [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold] per stack (letting you keep the borrowed [gold]Gold[/gold]).
USURER-MORATORIUM.title: Moratorium
USURER-MORATORIUM.description: Pauses turn-end [gold]Debt[/gold] Interest (+20%) and Installment damage for [blue]1[/blue] turn per stack.
